title: ForeAct: Steering Your VLA with Efficient Visual Foresight Planning
scope: Embodied image generation supplement: image and language conditioned future-view generation used to guide a VLA, not pure text-to-image. SANA-1.6B initialized flow-matching generator plus VLM subtask planning and fine-tuned VLA.
reading_scope: Main text pp.1-9; appendices pp.12-16 including OOD cases, VLM evaluation/prompt and task protocols; references indexed, not independently verified; rendered p.6 Table 1/Figures 6-8 and p.9 Table 4/Figure 12 checked.
caveats: Real-world 87.4% is a score based on completed atomic actions with penalties, not an all-or-nothing full-task success rate (p.7). LIBERO uses a different success-rate protocol, 500 trials per suite (p.8).
No VLA architecture change does not mean no training: both image generator and VLA receive deployment-data fine-tuning.
The paper image generator uses the head-camera view only; later code announcements of multi-view foresight are not attributed to the v1 paper.
Figure 7 provides two selected qualitative examples of general image editors, not a systematic demonstration of their universal inability.
The work does not test poisoning, attribution, backdoor removal, or weight repair.
